evidence: Modifies `src/wallet/migration.cpp`, `src/wallet/wallet.cpp`, and `src/wallet/walletdb.cpp` to optimize legacy-to-SQLite wallet migration and drop unused wallet database methods.
rationale: Optimizes the legacy migration path by skipping redundant writes and deletes, while cleaning up unused wallet record deletion methods. Migration already works, so skipping redundant disk I/O and dropping unused functions (`RemoveTxs`, `EraseTx`, `EraseRecords`) is worthwhile maintainability and efficiency work without being urgent.
